name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Choir goes with at least one of Frost or History.
Hale does not go with Rowing.
Either Choir goes with Ellis or Ellis goes with Geography.
Either Chess goes with Music or Ames goes with Rowing.
Chess, Choir, and Robotics go with Ames, Frost, and Geography, in some order.
Chess goes with Music if and only if History goes with Nash.
Biology goes with none of Ames, Ellis, or Debate.
